body:
# DominoMod

Place colored dominoes and watch them topple in a chain reaction.

![image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3b8fbc5c0472887b688d8fae8956a115364492be.png)
## Features

- **148 colors** — one domino block for every CSS color name.
- **Physics-style chain toppling** — knocking one domino over cascades to the dominoes in front of it.
- **16 placement directions** — dominoes face the way you look, with a live wireframe preview before you place.
- **Smooth toppling animation** — each domino tilts as it falls and leans against the next one.
- **Stand them back up** — raise a fallen line one domino at a time.
- **Gravity** — a domino with no support falls straight down.
- **Multi-loader** — runs on both Forge and Fabric.

## Controls

- **Place** — hold a domino and right-click a surface. It faces your view direction; a wireframe shows where it lands.
- **Topple** — walk into a standing domino to knock it over and start the chain.
- **Stand up** — right-click a fallen domino. Raise from the back of the line: a domino that another is leaning on can't be raised until the one resting on it is.
- **Break** — left-click to mine a domino (standing or fallen).
